title: GNSS: multi-band EGNOS file format and SBAS L5
description:
Add support for multi-band EGNOS file format (supported by dissecting EMS files as lines of ASCII strings).
Add basic dissector for SBAS L5 messages.

commits_data.title: GNSS: resolve bitmask warning for SBAS L1 MT25
commits_data.message:
GNSS: resolve bitmask warning for SBAS L1 MT25

For octet-aligned IOD octet, no bits need to be displayed.
Set bit mask for such IOD to 0 to resolve bitmask warning by
tools/check_typed_item_calls.py
